body:
WHAT
FileState gains changedSinceRead(): the files Read this session whose mtime or size moved since (checkFresh's own test, over every recorded file; a deleted file counts). A foreground Bash call takes that list before it spawns and again when the command closes; the files new to the list are named at the end of its result: "[This command changed a file you had Read: <path>. Read it again before you Edit.]" (at most ten named, the rest counted). Files stale before the command are not named. Background commands are not covered: their output arrives later and cannot be attributed to one call. Measured cost: two stat passes over 500 Read files take 8–11 ms, against a shell spawn of ~100 ms.

WHY
Field test 2026-09-23, finding E-04. Bash never touched FileState; checkFresh still caught a file changed by a shell command, but only at the next Edit, which was refused as "modified on disk since it was last read" with no word about which command did it — so the model re-read and re-quoted by trial.

WHERE
engine/core/src/runtime/fileState.ts changedSinceRead(); engine/core/src/agent/tool.ts FileStateStore; engine/tools/src/bash.ts runForeground().

TEST CHECKLIST
1. (proc) With a.txt Read, a real shell command that appends to it gets a result naming a.txt; a command that touches nothing gets no note; a file changed by someone else before the command is not named by it.
